notes: Live Activities ab proxy ke zariye bhi send hoti hai — Pakistan mein direct Telegram band hai, is liye Group Setup mein proxy setting aa gayi hai (SOCKS5 / HTTP, jo aap khud dalenge). Attach dabane par Telegram jaisa gallery panel khulta hai — camera, photos aur videos chun kar ek saath bhejein. Live Activities ka theme ab app ke theme ke saath chalta hai — light ho to light, dark ho to dark.
releaseNotes: Flashy v2.25: (1) Live Activities proxy — Pakistan se Telegram direct nahi khulta jis ki wajah se messages clock par atak jate thay. Ab Live Activities ki Group Setup mein Proxy setting hai: SOCKS5 ya HTTP proxy on karke host/port (aur username/password ho to woh bhi) dal dein — saari Live Activities sending usi proxy se jayegi; proxy off ho to pehle ki tarah direct jayegi. Proxy ki details server par mehfooz hoti hain aur password screen par kabhi nazar nahi ata. Agar network na mile to message clock par hamesha ke liye nahi atkega — failed ho jayega jahan se Resend ya Delete ho sakta hai. (2) Attach panel Telegram jaisa — attach dabane par neeche gallery khulti hai: pehla cell Camera, us ke baad phone ki photos/videos; jitni marzi select karein (number lag jata hai), phir Add dabane par composer mein aa jati hain aur caption ke saath send hoti hain. Neeche File, Inward Gate Pass aur Outward Gate Pass ki rows bhi hain. (3) Theme fix — Live Activities pehle hamesha dark rehti thi chahe app light ho; asal wajah mil gayi aur theek kar di — ab LA bilkul app ke theme ke saath chalti hai, Themes se light/dark badalte hi LA bhi usi waqt badal jati hai. Verification: asal Chromium probe 13/13 (dark/light theme, 2 members, proxy save, gallery select + send); proxy mechanism ka saboot — local SOCKS5 aur HTTP proxies ke through asal group mein message aur photo pohanchay aur delete bhi hue; APK badging versionCode 35 / 2.25, signer purana wala.
